message.content:
Here’s a mix of classic chills and modern scares you might enjoy:

| # | Title | Year | Why it’s worth watching |
|---|-------|------|--------------------------|
| 1 | **The Shining** (1980) | A psychological masterpiece with iconic imagery and an unsettling atmosphere. |
| 2 | **Hereditary** (2018) | A slow‑burn family drama that turns into a terrifying descent into madness. |
| 3 | **Get Out** (2017) | Sharp social commentary wrapped in a suspenseful thriller. |
| 4 | **A Quiet Place** (2018) | Tension builds around silence; great for a group watching together. |
| 5 | **Midsommar** (2019) | A daylight horror that subverts expectations with its vivid, unsettling visuals. |
| 6 | **It Follows** (2014) | A fresh take on the “invisible stalker” trope with a creepy soundtrack. |
| 7 | **The Conjuring** (2013) | A well‑crafted haunted house story that pays homage to classic ghost tales. |
| 8 | **The Babadook** (2014) | Psychological depth meets supernatural dread in a very intimate setting. |
| 9 | **Suspiria** (1977) | For those who love surreal, stylistic terror with a haunting score. |
|10 | **The Witch** (2015) | Slow‑burn dread set in a meticulously researched Puritan setting. |

Feel free to pick based on your mood—whether you want a classic, a modern twist, or something that will keep you on the edge of your seat!
